name: Jellyfin
description: Media server for audio, video, books, comics, and photos with a sleek interface and robust transcoding capabilities. Almost all modern platforms have clients, including Roku, Android TV, iOS, and Kodi. ([Demo](https://demo.jellyfin.org/stable), [Source Code](https://github.com/jellyfin/jellyfin), [Clients](https://github.com/awesome-jellyfin/awesome-jellyfin)) `GPL-2.0` `C#/deb/Docker`
